title: Healthchecks ping URL hardcoded as a fallback in the public repo's cron script (4/12-6/06); check rotated 6/06
tier_reason: exposed alerting credential with no evidenced misuse (a spoofed success ping could have masked an outage, a spoofed /fail could have raised a false alarm); rotated and the box cut over on 6/06

contract.text: No live alerting credential is committed to the public repository; only the box can ping its Healthchecks check.
contract.source: 681eb8c body; CLAUDE.md ('cron-setup now REQUIRES HEALTHCHECKS_PING_URL (no hardcoded default)')

mechanism.text: scripts/cron-setup-hetzner.sh set HC_PING_URL to ${HEALTHCHECKS_PING_URL:-<hardcoded hc-ping URL>}, publishing the live check's ping UUID in the public repo from d5c466c (2026-04-12)

mitigated.action: leaked check rotated to a new UUID and the box's cron cut over to it

residual.text: The old ping URL stays in public git history (inert after the rotation)

watchdog.trigger: credential hygiene (a secret scan of the public repo), not a W4 rank-2 boundary

evidence.what: the hardcoded hc-ping fallback 'was leaked in this public repo'; the variable is now required; the leaked check was rotated to a new UUID and the box cut over
the hardcoded fallback URL is present from the script's first version
pre-deploy eaccaf8 -> deployed 2b752be (contains 681eb8c) at 2026-06-07T00:11:21Z, canary passed

notes: deployed (log) records the script change reaching the box checkout; it only matters at the next crontab install. The effective fix was the rotation (mitigated)
the repo's visibility on 4/12 and when the leak was noticed are not recorded; the ping UUID is deliberately not reproduced here
not on the W4 path; the lead may keep it as a hygiene item or drop it
